task.dueDateStorage: nullable @db.Date; timestamp input and date-only persisted projection must remain distinct
task.creator: current tenant actor; not model input
task.clientResolution: current tenant visibility; UUID lookup or case-insensitive unique name; no admission of authority from this structural contract

filing.inputArray: legacy IDs1..10 then dedup; immutable ObjectReference is a different public type needing trusted mapping
filing.preStoragePending: missing data or mediaType -> pending with fileName/reason and no document tuple
filing.missingAttachment: failed with null fileName/reason, no document tuple
filing.persisted: document.id required; quarantined->pending/not_indexed; other disallowed nonnull lifecycle->failed/not_indexed; allowed/null->saved with indexedAt ? indexed : pending; reused true only exact booleantrue
filing.destination: current client wall and tenant/status + current actor conversation not archived + compatible conversation client
filing.cancellation: request-active check before write and inside catch, so cancellation may stop later siblings
filing.partial: saved/pending/failed observations do not decide public aggregate receipt outcome or readability

publicCorrelation.receipt: stable tenantId/actorId/conversationId/runId, recovery attempt/worker/fence may differ
publicCorrelation.scope: same tenant, immutable exact attachment scopes and exact receipt-command scopes; no invented union/destination authorization
publicCorrelation.artifactVersion: optional generated-origin object match; logical ArtifactVersion.versionId differs from storage ObjectReference.versionId
